affected.note: Member records. For about 60% of customers, the leaked fields may be limited to birthdate, email address and hashed password. Bank account details were included for 10 records.

summary.en: SODA, operator of the sneaker marketplace app SNKRDUNK, found on 2022-06-07 that its database had been accessed without authorization. 2,753,400 member records, including names, addresses, birthdates, email addresses and hashed passwords, may have been leaked.
summary.ja: スニーカーフリマアプリ「SNKRDUNK」を運営するSODAは、2022年6月7日にデータベースへの不正アクセスが発覚したと公表した。氏名、住所、生年月日、メールアドレス、ハッシュ化パスワードなどを含む会員情報275万3,400件が流出した可能性がある。
